39
Two test-tubes each contain a sample of water. One test-tube contains pure water, but the other
test-tube contains water and dissolved sodium chloride as an impurity.
Which tests may be used to identify the test-tube that contains pure water?
1
Measure the boiling point of each water sample.
2
Test each sample with acidified aqueous silver nitrate.
3
Test each sample with anhydrous copper(II) sulfate.
A
B
C
D
1 and 2
1 only
2 and 3
3 only
subject: Chemistry
